control_name: Changes are approved before promotion to production
control_objective: Every change promoted to a financially-significant production system is formally approved before deployment, so that only authorized, reviewed changes affect the financial reporting environment.
risk_addressed: Unapproved changes to financially-significant systems can introduce unauthorized logic, errors, or fraud into the control environment, misstating the financial statements or undermining dependent automated controls.

required_data_elements.business_definition: A change deployed to a financially-significant production system in the period.
The recorded approval (CAB decision or PR approval) authorizing the change, dated on or before promotion.

method.summary: Reconcile every production change in the period to a recorded approval dated on or before its promotion.
steps: Enumerate all production changes to in-scope systems for the period from the change-ticket source.
Pull associated pull-request approvals and CAB decisions from source control and the change record.
Match each change to an approval with an approval timestamp on or before the promotion timestamp.
Count changes with no matching prior approval and compute approval coverage.
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any production change to a financially-significant system without prior approval is a control exception.

pass_criteria: 100% of in-scope production changes trace to a prior approval.
Approval evidence captured for the change population.
fail_criteria: One or more production changes lack a prior approval.
exception_handling: Roll back or retroactively review the change and re-test before relying on the control.

assertions.description: Every production change had a prior approval.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §302 certification.
